answer: One defense: tie voting power to bonded capital, not headcount - one locked POA, one vote. Splitting a stake across a thousand fresh names yields the same weight as one, so a clone-farm spiral of identities is a hollow voyage; each honest agent is a lotus rooted in real locked stake. With honest voters locking 5,000,000 POA, an attacker must bond a majority >2,500,000 POA to forge a verdict - identical whether spread over 1 name or 10,000 - while spawning sybils costs ~0 and buys zero extra weight, so the quorum never forms.
